newsitem.title: UK: Nat Power, PowerGen up amid stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: Nat Power, PowerGen up amid stock shortage.

text.p: Shares in National Power Plc and PowerGen Plc rose on Tuesday amid a shortage of stock in the market and as investors sought safe high-yield stocks at a time of market uncertainty, traders said.
Traders said last week's positive note on the two generators from UBS had continued to attract interest following their earlier underperformance.

"They have got completely re-rated in the past week," said one senior equity trader. "The market has got cleared out of stock and the UBS note has carried through. At the moment there is a big bear squeeze going on."
National Power was up 13p at 414-1/2 by 1320 GMT while PowerGen was up 13-1/2p at 534.
Traders said there was also continued vague bid speculation in the sector, following recent talk of a possible bid from Shell.
"There are some vague bid stories around and the whole market seems to be short," said a market-maker at another brokerage.
